title: Cross-Chain and KYCed users will only pay a portion of the fees
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The factory contract calculates fees for cross-chain DAOs and KYC users as follows:  ```solidity     function checkDepositFeesSent(address _daoAddress, uint256 _totalAmount) internal {         if (ccDetails[_daoAddress].depositChainIds.length > 1 || isKycEnabled[_daoAddress]) {             require(msg.value >= _totalAmount + ((depositFees * platformFeeMultiplier) / 100), "Insufficient fees");         } else {             require(msg.value >= _totalAmount + depositFees, "Insufficient fees");         }     } ```  For exampl
